sources.citation: Den katolske kirke, "Festen for Kristi legeme og blod"

notes: Confirmed via SNL + Den katolske kirke. Important commemorative day in Norway until the Reformation; disappeared from Norwegian practice because Protestants don't recognize saint-related feasts, which is most of what the primstav's Catholic-era merkedager originally were. Still marked with Eucharistic processions in Trondheim, Ålesund, Oslo, Bergen and Stavanger today, and traditionally tied to Nidaros (St. Olav Cathedral, Trondheim).
